entries.kind.boon.name: Boon
entries.step.boons.title: Boons
entries.boon.raise.name: Grow Stronger
entries.boon.raise.short: You add 2 points to your scores.
entries.boon.raise.explain.what: Your training pays off. You get better at what you do most.
entries.boon.raise.explain.table: Add 2 points to one score, or 1 point each to two scores. No score goes above 15. You may take this boon again later.
entries.boon.keen-senses.name: Keen Senses
entries.boon.keen-senses.short: You notice more and keep your head.
entries.boon.keen-senses.explain.what: Your eyes and ears are sharp. Little escapes you.
entries.boon.keen-senses.explain.table: Add 1 point to wit or heart, and 1 to your nerve bonus.
entries.boon.sure-step.name: Sure Step
entries.boon.sure-step.short: You move faster and last longer.
entries.boon.sure-step.explain.what: Long roads made you tough and quick on your feet.
entries.boon.sure-step.explain.table: Your pace goes up by {{length:5}}. You get 1 more stamina for each level.
entries.boon.starlit-crown.name: Starlit Crown
entries.boon.starlit-crown.explain.what: A crown of starlight marks the greatest heroes of Mistland.
entries.boon.starlit-crown.explain.table: Your nerve bonus goes up by 2.
entries.boon.deep-practice.name: Deep Practice
entries.boon.deep-practice.short: One ability of your calling grows stronger.
entries.boon.deep-practice.explain.what: You practise one ability of your calling until it feels like breathing.
entries.boon.deep-practice.explain.table: Pick one ability your calling gave you. You may take this boon again, for another ability.
entries.trait.bright-beacon.name: Bright Beacon
entries.trait.bright-beacon.short: Your lantern lights up a whole hall.
entries.trait.bright-beacon.explain.what: For a moment, your lantern shines like the sun.
entries.trait.bright-beacon.explain.table: Everyone near you sees clearly, and hidden things show. Once per rest.
entries.trait.vow-of-dawn.name: Vow of Dawn
entries.trait.vow-of-dawn.short: Your light gives hope to your friends.
entries.trait.vow-of-dawn.explain.what: You swore to bring light to those in the dark.
entries.trait.vow-of-dawn.explain.table: Once per rest, one friend near you gets back 5 stamina.
entries.trait.vow-of-dusk.name: Vow of Dusk
entries.trait.vow-of-dusk.explain.what: You swore to guard the edge between day and night.
entries.trait.vow-of-dusk.explain.table: Once per rest, an enemy near you must wait a turn before it acts.
entries.trait.undying-flame.name: Undying Flame
entries.trait.undying-flame.short: Your light keeps you on your feet.
entries.trait.undying-flame.explain.what: As long as your lantern burns, you do not give up.
entries.trait.undying-flame.explain.table: When your stamina drops to 0, you stay standing with 1 stamina instead. This works every time.
entries.trait.current-sense.name: Current Sense
entries.trait.current-sense.explain.what: You know where the nearest water is, even under the ground.
entries.trait.current-sense.explain.table: Ask the game leader where the nearest water is. You always get an answer.
entries.trait.flood-stride.name: Flood Stride
entries.trait.flood-stride.short: You run as fast as a river.
entries.trait.flood-stride.explain.what: Your steps are as quick as running water.
entries.trait.river-heart.name: River Heart
entries.trait.river-heart.short: You shake off what would stop you.
entries.trait.river-heart.explain.what: Like a river around a stone, you go on.
entries.trait.river-heart.explain.table: As often per rest as your practice, you end one thing that holds you back, like a trap or a spell.
entries.trait.deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
entries.trait.deep-roots.short: Plants tell you who passed by.
entries.trait.deep-roots.explain.what: Grass and trees remember steps. You can ask them.
entries.trait.deep-roots.explain.table: Ask the game leader who walked here today. The plants answer in short words.
entries.trait.bloom-ward.name: Bloom Ward
entries.trait.bloom-ward.explain.what: A cloud of petals wraps around someone you choose.
entries.trait.bloom-ward.explain.table: Your friend's guard goes up by 2 until their next turn. Twice per rest, from level 17 three times.
entries.trait.old-growth.name: Old Growth
entries.trait.old-growth.short: You become as tough as an old tree.
entries.trait.old-growth.explain.what: Bark grows over your skin for a while.
entries.trait.old-growth.explain.table: For 1 minute, every hit takes 2 stamina less from you. Once per rest.
entries.knack.dawn-flare.name: Dawn Flare
entries.knack.dawn-flare.short: A burst of morning light blinds your foes.
entries.knack.dawn-flare.explain.what: You lift your lantern and a flash of light fills {{length:60}} around you.
entries.knack.dawn-flare.explain.table: Enemies close to you can't see on their next turn.
entries.knack.star-lantern.name: Star Lantern
entries.knack.star-lantern.short: A small star follows your group.
entries.knack.star-lantern.explain.what: A tiny star floats over your group and lights the way.
entries.knack.star-lantern.explain.table: For 1 hour, nobody in your group gets lost, even in fog.
entries.knack.sunrise.name: Sunrise
entries.knack.sunrise.short: You bring the morning, for a moment.
entries.knack.sunrise.explain.what: For 1 minute, it is bright day around you.
entries.knack.sunrise.explain.table: Creatures of the dark flee. Your friends get 1 luck token each.
entries.knack.whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
entries.knack.whirlpool.short: Water spins and holds your foes.
entries.knack.whirlpool.explain.what: You make water turn in a fast circle.
entries.knack.whirlpool.explain.table: Enemies in the water can't move for 1 minute.
entries.knack.tide-turn.name: Tide Turn
entries.knack.tide-turn.short: You turn bad luck into good luck.
entries.knack.tide-turn.explain.what: Like the tide, luck comes back to you.
entries.knack.tide-turn.explain.table: A friend near you may roll a failed roll again.
entries.knack.great-flood.name: Great Flood
entries.knack.great-flood.short: A wave washes the field clean.
entries.knack.great-flood.explain.what: You call a huge wave out of nowhere.
entries.knack.great-flood.explain.table: Enemies near you are swept away. Your friends stay where they are.
entries.knack.bramble-wall.name: Bramble Wall
entries.knack.bramble-wall.short: A wall of thorns grows out of the ground.
entries.knack.bramble-wall.explain.what: Thorny vines grow into a wall {{length:30}} long.
entries.knack.bramble-wall.explain.table: Nobody can walk through it for 1 hour.
entries.knack.heartwood.name: Heartwood
entries.knack.heartwood.short: A friend becomes as hard as wood.
entries.knack.heartwood.explain.what: You touch a friend, and their skin turns as hard as wood.
entries.knack.heartwood.explain.table: For 1 hour, your friend's guard goes up by 2.
entries.knack.forest-wake.name: Forest Wake
entries.knack.forest-wake.short: The trees wake up and help you.
entries.knack.forest-wake.explain.what: The trees around you move and fight for you.
entries.knack.forest-wake.explain.table: For 1 minute, the trees hold your enemies.

entries.choice.deep-practice.intro: Pick one ability your calling gave you. Each time you take this boon, you pick a different one.
entries.choice.lantern-vow.title: Lantern vow
entries.choice.lantern-vow.question: What did your character vow?
entries.choice.lantern-vow.intro: At level 11, every lantern bearer makes a vow. Pick one.
entries.choice.lantern-vow.variant.late.intro: At level 11 you made a vow. Now you are so experienced that your vow shapes everything you do. Pick one.

entries.trait.tide-crown.short: The river carries you: grace +2, up to 17.
entries.trait.tide-crown.explain.what: At the height of your journey, you move like water.
entries.trait.tide-crown.explain.table: Your grace goes up by 2. It can now reach 17.

entries.boon.rooted-focus.name: Rooted Focus
entries.boon.rooted-focus.short: You keep three knacks from your herb book at hand.
entries.boon.rooted-focus.explain.what: Your herb book is full. You keep at hand only what you need today.
entries.boon.rooted-focus.explain.table: Pick three root knacks from your herb book. Only these are at hand. After a night's rest you may swap them.
entries.choice.rooted-focus.title: Knacks at hand
entries.choice.rooted-focus.question: Which three knacks do you keep at hand?
entries.choice.rooted-focus.intro: Pick three root knacks written in your herb book. Borrowed knacks are always at hand anyway.
